actionAdapters.when: macOS/Linux 已解析到 Python 3.9+，且需要只读确认消费项目实际解析到的 Framework 包与随包 Docs 时
Windows 已解析到 Python 3.9+，且需要只读确认消费项目实际解析到的 Framework 包与随包 Docs 时

actionAdapters.entry: existing BuildReport, Unity Console, Editor.log, build invocation record, output artifacts, platform tool logs and matching resolved Framework BuildProcessor source
actionAdapters.when: 按原始时间线定位编译、BuildReport、staging、BuildProcessor、Android Gradle、iOS Xcode 或 WebGL 的最早直接失败证据；不重跑命令

actionAdapters.entry: read-only Unity Console, compilation status and existing build information inspection
actionAdapters.when: 当前 Unity 已打开且只需收集已有 Editor 证据；不触发刷新、编译、Play、Build、Resolve 或资产保存

deny: all project source, configuration, Scene, Prefab, Build Settings and generated output
Packages, Library/PackageCache, cache, Gradle, Xcode and WebGL output mutation or deletion
BuildPipeline, EditorUtil.Build, Pipify, EDM4U Resolve, Gradle, xcodebuild, WebGL export or any retry invocation
package install or upgrade, credential use, external write, Git commit or push

requiredFor: access to CI, device, remote Gradle, Xcode, store or other external logs outside the supplied project evidence scope
start Unity, trigger refresh or compilation, run Build/Resolve/Gradle/Xcode/WebGL commands, delete cache/output, or modify any project state
confirmation.rule: 本 Skill 的授权只允许收集既有证据；任何重试、修复、清理、构建、平台导出或项目写入均不属于本 Operation，必须在独立后续任务重新确认。

evidence: 实际解析的 Framework、原始构建入口、目标平台、输出路径与失败时间窗
最早直接失败的 BuildReport、Console、Editor.log、平台工具日志或 BuildProcessor 调用链位置
失败位于编译、Unity Build、staging、前处理、平台转换或后处理的证据分级，而非仅凭 Warning 推断
Android Gradle、iOS Xcode 或 WebGL 平台分支的直接证据或明确缺失记录
已验证事实、推断、未验证项和未执行任何重试/修复/写入的边界说明
